Project.How do you plan to prepare the dataset: To get the film and cultural data onto the Filecoin network, the first step is downloading the data and ensuring its completeness and accuracy. Next comes the data pre-processing stage, which involves converting file formats, compressing files, and extracting metadata to facilitate easier searching later on. Then, the data needs to be split into chunks suitable for Filecoin sector sizes, packaged into CAR files, and a PieceCID calculated for each CAR file. Selecting the right Storage Provider (SP) is crucial; factors such as their geographic location, supported retrieval protocols, and overall reputation must be carefully considered. Once the SP is chosen, the process moves to sector sealing, which involves generating zero-knowledge proofs (zk-SNARKs), followed by proposing the deal on-chain to officially store the data. After the storage provider accepts the deal and submits the Proof-of-Replication (PoRep) on-chain, they must continue submitting WindowPoSts to prove the data remains available and accessible. Ultimately, anyone can retrieve the stored data using the CID or other retrieval methods. Throughout this entire process, establishing robust data governance, designing effective incentive mechanisms for participation, and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations and standards are essential for guaranteeing the long-term security and shareability of the data.
